Asteria Engine Tech Portal

Building a Web Engine from Scratch

Asteria is a fast, data-oriented HTML5 and CSS3 document engine written in Rust with wgpu hardware GPU acceleration.

Core Architecture Highlights

The pipeline processes HTML tokens into a contiguous DOM arena, applies CSS cascading and inheritance, solves 2D bounding boxes, and builds display list GPU vertex batches.

Note: Multi-threaded background tasks and hardware quad batching enable fast 200+ FPS rendering performance.
